name: io.github.nakazanie-ton/xrocket
title: xRocket Exchange MCP
description: Autonomous xRocket CEX trading inside operator-set limits, plus live market data over MCP

environmentVariables.name: XROCKET_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool catalog: public, private-read, or full

environmentVariables.name: XROCKET_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: xRocket bearer token required for private profiles

environmentVariables.name: XROCKET_ENABLE_TRADING
environmentVariables.description: Allow autonomous order placement and cancellation inside the configured policy

environmentVariables.name: XROCKET_TRADING_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Required daily autonomous trading value when trading is enabled; for example 100 USD or 2.5 TONCOIN

environmentVariables.name: XROCKET_ENABLE_TRANSFERS
environmentVariables.description: Allow guarded internal funding/trading transfers in full profile

environmentVariables.name: XROCKET_ENABLE_WITHDRAWALS
environmentVariables.description: Allow guarded blockchain withdrawals in full profile

environmentVariables.name: XROCKET_ALLOW_MAINNET_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Additional explicit gate for every mainnet financial write

environmentVariables.name: XROCKET_APPROVAL_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Optional lifetime in milliseconds for prepared transfer and withdrawal approvals
